lines.japanese:
斎と葉子の兄妹は、冷遇されていた。
　使用人のような扱いをされていた。
lines.english: Itsuki and his sister Youko were treated coldly. They were treated as servants.

lines.japanese:
掃除は二人の役目だったし、時間も定められてい
た。
　手抜かりがあると、シンプルな体罰によって矯正
を促されたものだ。
lines.english: Cleaning was their responsibility, and it was performed at fixed hours. Any shortcoming was corrected with simple corporal punishment.

lines.japanese:
ところがその日ばかりは、大人たちが大部屋を占
拠している。
　道具を手に入室しようとすると、出て行けと指示
された。
lines.english: On this day alone, however, the adults had occupied the great room. When the children tried to enter with their cleaning tools, they were ordered out.

lines.japanese:
手持ちぶさたのまま、廊下にでも手をつけようと
したが、行き交う大人たちはそこにも大勢いた。
lines.english: At loose ends, they tried to start on the corridors, but those too were crowded with adults coming and going.

lines.japanese: 作業のできる状態ではない。
lines.english: There was no way to work.

lines.japanese:
兄妹の記憶によると、彼らは昨夜から延々と話し
合っていたはずだ。
lines.english: From what the siblings remembered, the adults had been talking without pause since the night before.

lines.japanese:
おそらく徹夜なのだろう。
　疲労と睡眠不足から、全員目のまわりを黒ずませ
ていた。
lines.english: They had probably been up all night. Fatigue and lack of sleep had left dark rings around everyone’s eyes.

lines.japanese:
投げやりに机に肘をつき、吸うでもない煙草を唇
に挟み、項垂れる者。
lines.english: One sat slumped at the table, a cigarette hanging unsmoked from his lips.

lines.japanese: 廊下に直に座り、顔を覆う者。
lines.english: Another sat on the bare corridor floor, face buried in his hands.

lines.japanese: なお活発に口論を続ける小集団。
lines.english: Small knots of people still argued heatedly.

lines.japanese:
五分ごとに高級車が門前に止まり、新たな人間が
ずかずかと挨拶もなく上がり込んでくる。
lines.english: Every five minutes, another luxury car stopped before the gate and someone new barged inside without so much as a greeting.

lines.japanese:
そして詰問口調で室内の論議に飛び込んでいくの
だ。
lines.english: Each newcomer plunged straight into the debate, demanding answers.

lines.japanese: 少年院だと！？　どういうことなんだ―――
lines.english: Juvenile detention?! What the hell is going on—

lines.japanese: 集団売春とリンチ行為などの疑いで―――
lines.english: Suspected organized prostitution and mob assault—

lines.japanese:
なぜこんな証拠が出てくる、まるで調査が入った
みたいじゃないか―――
lines.english: How did evidence like this surface? It's as if someone conducted a full investigation—

lines.japanese: 正道に自由にやらせすぎるから―――
lines.english: This is what comes of giving Seidou too free a hand—

lines.japanese:
あんただってゴマをすっていたさ、未来のご当主
様に―――
lines.english: You were currying favor too—with the future head of the family—

lines.japanese:
ええい、どうして手を回せないんだ、あまりにも
一方的すぎる―――
lines.english: Damn it, why can't anyone pull the necessary strings? This is far too one-sided—

lines.japanese: 穀潰しは黙っていろ―――
lines.english: Shut your mouth, you useless parasite—

lines.japanese:
貴様のところは落ち目だから被害も少ないだろう
が―――
lines.english: Your branch is already in decline, so I suppose you have less to lose—

lines.japanese: 嫡子が送致などとご先祖に詫びる言葉もない―――
lines.english: The heir being sent away... How can we ever face our ancestors—

lines.japanese: 終わりだ、全て終わりだ―――
lines.english: It's over. Everything is over—

lines.japanese:
なぜ今からでも関係者に再度手を回さないんだ、
こんなところで話し合っていても―――
lines.english: Why aren't we leaning on the relevant parties again, even now? Sitting here talking won't—

lines.japanese: まったく別系統からの働きかけが―――
lines.english: Pressure came from a completely separate channel—

lines.japanese: 裏切り者でもいるんじゃないのか―――
lines.english: Could there be a traitor among us—

lines.japanese:
こんな状況を放置しておけばつけこむ輩が出てく
るぞ―――
lines.english: If we leave matters like this, someone will seize the opening—

lines.japanese:
罵声。
　怒号。
　嘆息まじりの悲鳴。
lines.english: Curses. Bellows of rage. Screams threaded with despairing sighs.

lines.japanese:
場は混沌としており、収束に向かう気配はなかっ
た。
lines.english: The room was chaos, with no sign it would ever settle.

lines.japanese: ただ一色、絶望と混乱に支配されていた。
lines.english: Everything was steeped in a single hue: despair and confusion.

lines.japanese:
飛び交う言語。
　無数の情報。
lines.english: Words flying through the air. A torrent of information.

lines.japanese: と
lines.english: apostles

lines.japanese:
秩序の徒たる大人たちによる、混迷。
　理解を超えていたのかも知れない。
lines.english: adults, apostles of order, sunk in confusion. Perhaps it lay beyond her comprehension.
“...Ah, ah, ah, ah!”

lines.japanese: 葉子は悲鳴を発した。
lines.english: Youko screamed.

lines.japanese:
声が裏返り、引きつれを起こしたように身が震え
る。
lines.english: Her voice cracked. Her body convulsed as though seized by a spasm.

lines.japanese: 誰かが叫ぶ。
lines.english: Someone shouted.

lines.japanese: うるさいぞ、外に連れていけ。
lines.english: She's too loud. Take her outside.

lines.japanese:
言われるまでもなく、斎は妹の肩を抱いて外に向
かった。
lines.english: He needed no prompting. Itsuki put an arm around his sister's shoulders and led her outside.

lines.japanese:
誰かが感情的にバケツを蹴飛ばす。
　水は縁側から庭にまかれた。
lines.english: Someone kicked over a bucket in a burst of anger. Water spilled from the veranda into the garden.

lines.japanese:
傾く妹の体を強く支え、斎は外に向かう。
　途中、正道の私室前を通る。
　襖が開け放たれ、門倉正道が立っていた。
lines.english: Supporting his sister's sagging body, Itsuki made for the exit. On the way, they passed Seidou's private room. The sliding door stood wide open, and Seidou Kadokura was there.

lines.japanese:
生気の失せた顔。
　寝ていないのか血走った目。
lines.english: His face was drained of life. His eyes were bloodshot, perhaps from lack of sleep.

lines.japanese:
そして室内のいたるところに、刃物で切り裂かれ
た跡があった。
lines.english: Cuts from a blade scored every part of the room.

lines.japanese:
濁った目が斎に向いた。
　死んだ魚を思わせた。
lines.english: Clouded eyes turned toward Itsuki. Dead fish eyes.

lines.japanese:
焦点さえ合わなかったのか、そのまま通り過ぎて
葉子に。
lines.english: Perhaps they could not even focus. They drifted past Itsuki and came to rest on Youko.

lines.japanese: 許嫁。
lines.english: His betrothed.

lines.japanese:
それは象徴だ。
　自由恋愛ではない定められた婚姻関係こそ、門倉
には有用かつ誇りあるものだった。
lines.english: She was a symbol. To Kadokura, an arranged marriage rather than a love match was both useful and honorable.

lines.japanese: 手を伸ばした。
lines.english: He reached out.

lines.japanese:
「無能な……大人が……
　くそ、俺があと五年早く生まれていれば……
　このようなことには……」
lines.english: “Useless... adults... Damn it. If I'd only been born five years earlier... none of this would have...”

lines.japanese: 少年の手が、葉子の首にかかる。
lines.english: The boy's hand closed around Youko's throat.
“...Forgive me.”

lines.japanese:
門倉の首筋に、斎の指が絡みついた。
　普段の門倉正道ならば、許すことのない行動だっ
た。心理的にも、技量面でも。
lines.english: Itsuki's fingers closed around the side of Kadokura's neck. Under ordinary circumstances, Seidou Kadokura would never have allowed it—not in temperament, and not in terms of skill.

lines.japanese: しかし、
lines.english: But—

lines.japanese:
権力者として羽化直前だった少年は、寄る辺を失
ったことで揺らぎ、あっけなく意識を手放した。
lines.english: The boy had stood on the verge of emerging as a man of power. Now every support had fallen away; he faltered and surrendered consciousness without a struggle.

lines.japanese:
頽れる。
　完全に気絶していた。
lines.english: He crumpled. Completely unconscious.

lines.japanese: 「……俺は……俺は」
危険な行動だ。
lines.english: It had been a dangerous act.

lines.japanese:
もし平時だったら穏便には済まない。
　主人に手をかけるなど。
lines.english: In ordinary times, it would not have ended quietly. To lay hands on his master...

lines.japanese:
なぜそんなことをしたのか。
　彼は葉子に手をつける権利さえあった。
lines.english: Why had he done it? Kadokura even had the right to lay hands on Youko.

lines.japanese:
斎は諦めていた。
　何も望まなかった。
　混乱の波が、斎自身にも感染していたせいなのか。
lines.english: Itsuki had given up. He wanted nothing. Was it only that the wave of confusion had infected him as well?

lines.japanese:
そればかりが、今の小さな反逆の原因ではないこ
とを……本人はまだ自覚していない。
lines.english: He did not yet realize that confusion alone could not account for this small rebellion.

lines.japanese:
葉子を連れて行く。
　外に。
lines.english: He took Youko with him. Outside.

lines.japanese:
罵倒悪口の連なりが、合唱となって追いかけてく
る。
lines.english: An endless chain of curses and insults pursued them in chorus.

lines.japanese:
深く古く長い屋敷の奥から。
　外に。
lines.english: From deep inside the old, sprawling house. Outside.

lines.japanese:
通用門を抜け、雑然ととめられた車の間をぬって、
　外に―――
lines.english: Through the service gate, weaving between the haphazardly parked cars—outside.

lines.japanese: そこに、
lines.english: And there—

lines.japanese: 「塚本君」
lines.english: “Tsukamoto.”

lines.japanese:
斎の全身を、衝撃が貫いた。
　心の隙をも確実に突いた。
lines.english: A shock tore through Itsuki's entire body. It struck unerringly at the opening in his heart.

lines.japanese: 「……遊びに、行かないか？」
lines.english: “...Want to go somewhere and play?”

lines.japanese:
どこかぎこちない、命令のような誘い。
　外に出て、それからどうするのか。
　斎は考えてなかった。
lines.english: The invitation was awkward, almost an order. What was he to do once he got outside? Itsuki had never thought that far.

lines.japanese:
確かに忍と彼らは、接点がある。
　友達であるかはともかく、知り合いではある。
　縁であるには違いない。
lines.english: There was, undeniably, a connection between Shinobu and the siblings. Friends or not, they knew one another. Some bond existed between them.

lines.japanese:
だが、
　今ここで忍の要求に応じるということは―――
lines.english: But to accept Shinobu's request here and now would mean—

lines.japanese: 斎は屋敷を振り返る。
lines.english: Itsuki looked back at the house.

lines.japanese:
葉子を見る。
　そして忍を見る。
lines.english: He looked at Youko. Then at Shinobu.

lines.japanese: どれくらい、時間が過ぎ去ったのか。
lines.english: How long passed?

lines.japanese: 掠れた笑いが、喉の奥から漏れた。
lines.english: A hoarse laugh escaped from deep in his throat.

lines.japanese: 「ははは、ははははは……」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha... ha ha ha ha...”

lines.japanese:
ほとんど気を失った妹を抱えたまま、斎は膝を折
る。
lines.english: Still supporting his nearly unconscious sister, Itsuki sank to his knees.

lines.japanese:
塀に背中をつけ、忍の見ている前、手で顔を覆っ
た。
lines.english: He leaned his back against the wall and covered his face with both hands, right in front of Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「……おまえは、いったいなんなんだ」
lines.english: “...What in the world are you?”

lines.japanese:
呪詛でも疑問でもない言葉。
　忍という存在を、斎はまだ理解できない。
lines.english: The words were neither a curse nor a question. Itsuki still could not understand Shinobu's very existence.

lines.japanese:
混乱のさなかに唐突にあらわれ、判じかねる仕方
で友好を告げる少年。
lines.english: A boy who had appeared without warning amid the chaos and declared friendship in a way Itsuki could not decipher.

lines.japanese:
まともではない。
　異質でしかない。
lines.english: He was not normal. He was simply alien.

lines.japanese:
斎らの人生と、少しも関わるところのない……絶
対の他者。
lines.english: An absolute other, with no connection whatsoever to the lives Itsuki and his sister had lived.

lines.japanese:
まるで助けに来たようなタイミングにも思える。
　あるはずがない。
　偶然だ。
lines.english: Even his timing made it seem as though he had come to save them. Impossible. A coincidence.

lines.japanese:
だが斎は錯乱し、動けなくなる。
　全てを心に納得させるためには、まず時間と過程
が必要だ。
lines.english: But Itsuki was too distraught to move. Before his heart could accept any of it, he needed time—and a process.

lines.japanese:
どちらも斎にはまだない。
　これから、一つずつたぐり寄せねばならないのだ
った。
lines.english: He had neither. He would have to feel his way toward both, one step at a time.

lines.japanese: 「いったい、コレは、どういうことなんだ―――」
lines.english: “What... what is any of this supposed to mean—?”

lines.japanese:
虚空に問いかける斎を、忍は黙って見下ろしてい
た。
lines.english: Shinobu silently looked down at Itsuki as the boy questioned the empty air.

lines.japanese:
考えること。
　もがくこと。
lines.english: To think. To struggle.

lines.japanese:
それが停滞という迷路を抜ける、苦しみの救い道
であると、後に忍は知る。
lines.english: Only later would Shinobu learn that thinking and struggling offered a path out of suffering and through the maze of stasis.

lines.japanese:
そう―――苦しみなくして、納得などありはしな
いのだから。人は。
lines.english: Yes—because there can be no acceptance without suffering. Not for a human being.
